metrics.validation: 5-fold GroupKFold by 0.5° geographic cell (tested on unseen areas)

regional_check.note: Observers in the region see fewer stars than a model trained mostly on USA/Europe predicts -> local haze/dust; motivates local photo calibration.

data_sources.target: Globe at Night SQM readings 2019-2025 (NOIRLab), mag/arcsec²
data_sources.satellite: NASA GIBS VIIRS_Black_Marble 2016 (Suomi-NPP VIIRS DNB), linear light index 0-1

limits: Valid for SQM 16-22.3 mag/arcsec²; night-time only (sun below -12°).
VIIRS index is a visual-product proxy, not calibrated radiance; 2016 composite.
Training data is mostly USA/Europe; Middle East checked separately with naked-eye reports.
Dust (AOD) not yet a feature — photos from Iraq are used to measure the local offset.
